description:
Several behaviors reported by sweep workers contradict a documented or implied contract in `crates/gf2-core/src/`.

## Background

Reported locations: `io/bitvec.rs:233` (hex with too few words hits the `from_words` assert); `io/sparse.rs:187,228,422,476` (`Vec::with_capacity` on an untrusted `nnz`); `io/sparse.rs:110` (`as u32` truncates silently); `bench_seed.rs:151` (`bitmatrix_from_seed` uses `StdRng`, while the removed doc claimed a SplitMix64 stream byte-identical to `m4ri_bench.c`); `field/axiom_tests.rs:189` (`ilog2(p) * m` equals $\lfloor \log_2 p^m \rfloor$ only for $p = 2$); `field/triangular.rs:1109` (`trtrm` passes the full `U22` block to `gemm_into_view`, so cells below the diagonal of `U` are read); `field/matrix.rs:2284` (`UnitDiagView::transpose` drops the implicit unit diagonal; its constructor is dead code).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces each reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and that item is dropped with the evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: Loaders return an error on malformed input, covered by tests.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each remaining item is fixed with a test, or its precondition is stated in Rustdoc.
title: gf2-core loader, seed-stream and field-kernel defects reported by the comment sweep
